read_relevant_paragraphs: P00007: “Printed” means that the listed page image was visually inspected in the specified edition. “Electronic” means a page label displayed by a transcription, without a new scan collation. “Hosted lines” identify the bounded retrieved passage, not permanent lines in a printed edition. Numbered website subsections such as 003 or 016 are not volume numbers. PDF pages below are one-based unless expressly stated otherwise.

P00008: A local rereading can verify a retained passage without adding a new source or independent witness. Different hosts may reproduce the same edition. The read ranges describe the underlying research inspections; preparing this guide did not repeat every primary-source reading. No complete author-corpus reading, manuscript collation or outside human-specialist review is claimed.

P00009: The broader traversal does not turn every source assertion into a verified fact, every report into authenticated testimony or every interpretative judgement into a theorem. A complete traversal of the selected printed witness also does not recover its author’s complete lost original. These qualifications limit what the source reading establishes.

P00040: Shifāʾ al-ʿalīl supplies two important controls. The permitted Shamela transcription at electronic 1:485 affirms real created efficacy while distinguishing coequal powers intrinsic to their bearers. Electronic 1:472 reports rival schools' positions. The author's affirmative reply must be separated from the objection it answers. Electronic 1:485; electronic 1:472.

P00041: The retained IslamHouse reads cover lines 831–837, 1132–1141 and 1231–1235, including electronically labelled 1:149–150 and 1:231–233. The parallel Islamicbook subsection 003 was read only in targeted paragraphs labelled 209 and 232. These locate the derivation of powers, intended ends and integrated order. The integration paragraph has a textual discontinuity. It remains unrepaired; a subsequently excluded scan supplies neither wording nor certified print pagination here. Retained electronic parallel.

P00042: Miftāḥ dār al-saʿāda was read electronically at part 1, lines 860–868, labelled 1:393–396, and part 2, lines 459–464, labelled 2:94–96. These supply unity analogies and a discussion of equal opposing causal tendencies. Edition and print mapping were not established. Later access denials added no usable readings. Part 1; part 2.

new_witness_relation: Separately permitted Islamicbook electronic body. It does not repair or authenticate the denied scan, and host independence does not establish independent historical transmission.
acquisition_only_not_reading: Acquisition and machine extraction confer no reading credit. Initial huge raw HTML display was truncated and is not credited; all credited reads use the later stable page windows.
